name: Taylorcraft F-21 / F-22
summary: 1980s-90s revival of the classic Taylorcraft side-by-side two-seat high-wing with a modern Lycoming engine. The F-22A variant has tricycle gear.

wings: High wing braced by a strut on each side
engines: Single Lycoming O-235 or O-360 flat-four in a cowl
fuselage: Side-by-side two-seat cabin with large windows
Fixed tailwheel gear on F-21; tricycle gear on F-22A/C

tellTales: Side-by-side two-seat high-wing with a strut each side
Postwar-style light two-seater with a modern cowl
Tailwheel or tricycle gear on a small tube-and-fabric-looking airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The BC-12 is the prewar original with a smaller engine and rounder tail; the F-21/F-22 is the 1980s Lycoming-powered revival.
The 150 is a metal tricycle-gear trainer with a thick lift strut; the F-21 is a tube-and-fabric tailwheel two-seater.
The Chief has a deep, rounded cabin and an older cowl; the F-21 has a boxier cabin and a larger modern engine.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
